mapper.select: select count(1) from edu_submission s join edu_task t on t.task_id = s.task_id join edu_course c on c.course_id = t.course_id where c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} and s.status = 2 and t.del_flag = '0'
select count(1) from edu_recommendation r where r.status = 1 and (r.teacher_id is null or r.teacher_id != #{auditorId})
select count(1) from edu_task_participant p join edu_task t on t.task_id = p.task_id where p.user_id = #{userId} and t.status = 1 and t.del_flag = '0' and p.submit_status in (0, 4)
select count(1) from edu_recommendation r join edu_submission s on s.submission_id = r.submission_id where r.status = 0 and s.user_id = #{userId}
